description: This file defines an abstract class 'MemoryManagerEmbeddingOps' that manages embedding operations, including batching, caching, error handling, and database interactions for memory chunks and embeddings in a larger system.

classes.name: MemoryManagerEmbeddingOps
classes.description: An abstract class extending MemoryManagerSyncOps, responsible for managing embedding operations including batching, caching, error handling, and database interactions for memory chunks and embeddings.

methods.name: buildEmbeddingBatches
methods.description: Creates batches of memory chunks for embedding, respecting maximum token limits.

methods.name: loadEmbeddingCache
methods.description: Loads cached embeddings from the database based on provided hashes.

methods.name: upsertEmbeddingCache
methods.description: Inserts or updates embedding cache entries in the database.

methods.name: pruneEmbeddingCacheIfNeeded
methods.description: Removes old entries from the embedding cache if it exceeds maximum size.

methods.name: embedChunksInBatches
methods.description: Embeds memory chunks in batches, utilizing cache and handling missing embeddings.

methods.name: computeProviderKey
methods.description: Computes a unique key for the embedding provider configuration.

methods.name: buildBatchDebug
methods.description: Creates a debug function for batch processing logs.

methods.name: embedChunksWithBatch
methods.description: Embeds chunks using batch embedding with fallback to individual embedding if needed.

methods.name: collectCachedEmbeddings
methods.description: Collects cached embeddings and identifies missing ones.

methods.name: embedBatchWithRetry
methods.description: Embeds a batch of texts with retry logic for transient errors.

methods.name: embedBatchInputsWithRetry
methods.description: Embeds structured inputs with retry logic for transient errors.

methods.name: waitForEmbeddingRetry
methods.description: Waits for a specified delay before retrying embedding operations.

methods.name: isRetryableEmbeddingError
methods.description: Determines if an error message indicates a transient, retryable error.

methods.name: resolveEmbeddingTimeout
methods.description: Resolves timeout durations based on provider and operation type.

methods.name: embedQueryWithTimeout
methods.description: Embeds a query with timeout handling.

methods.name: withTimeout
methods.description: Wraps a promise with a timeout, rejecting if the timeout is exceeded.

methods.name: withBatchFailureLock
methods.description: Ensures exclusive access to batch failure state updates.

methods.name: resetBatchFailureCount
methods.description: Resets batch failure counters and logs recovery.

methods.name: recordBatchFailure
methods.description: Records a batch failure, updating counters and possibly disabling batch processing.

methods.name: isBatchTimeoutError
methods.description: Checks if an error message indicates a batch timeout.

methods.name: runBatchWithTimeoutRetry
methods.description: Runs a batch operation with timeout and retry on timeout errors.

methods.name: runBatchWithFallback
methods.description: Runs a batch operation with fallback to non-batch if it fails.

methods.name: getIndexConcurrency
methods.description: Returns the concurrency level for indexing, depending on batch enablement.

methods.name: clearIndexedFileData
methods.description: Deletes indexed data related to a file from database tables.

methods.name: upsertFileRecord
methods.description: Inserts or updates a file record in the database.

methods.name: deleteFileRecord
methods.description: Deletes a file record from the database.

methods.name: isStructuredInputTooLargeError
methods.description: Checks if an error message indicates a structured input is too large.

methods.name: writeChunks
methods.description: Writes memory chunks and their embeddings into database tables, handling both vector and FTS indexes.

methods.name: indexFile
methods.description: Indexes a file by chunking, embedding, and storing chunks and embeddings, with special handling for multimodal files.
